attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Arizona state income tax. Flat 2.5% rate (ARS § 43-1011, 2025) applied to AGI minus the filing-status standard deduction (floored at 0). Standard deductions: $15,750 Single/MFS/HOH, $31,500 MFJ/QSS. Writes result.az_taxable_income and result.az_state_tax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.az_state_tax = 0; set result.az_taxable_income = 0; add " Arizona Tax Calculation (Form 140) - flat 2.5%" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.az_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.az_taxable_income xdef " Arizona Tax Calculation (Form 140) - flat 2.5%" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.az_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 31500.0) and 0.0; set result.az_state_tax = result.az_taxable_income * 0.025
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 31500.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.az_taxable_income xdef result.az_taxable_income 0.025 fmul cvd /result.az_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.az_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 15750.0) and 0.0; set result.az_state_tax = result.az_taxable_income * 0.025
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 15750.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.az_taxable_income xdef result.az_taxable_income 0.025 fmul cvd /result.az_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.az_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 15750.0) and 0.0; set result.az_state_tax = result.az_taxable_income * 0.025
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 15750.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.az_taxable_income xdef result.az_taxable_income 0.025 fmul cvd /result.az_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Publish state result to the generic computed_state_tax fields
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.az_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.az_state_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.az_taxable_income cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.az_state_tax cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Arizona military retirement income exclusion. Skeleton: per ARS § 43-1022 (2025), provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA / SCRA. Not currently wired in — see issue #446.
